release_notes:
Release v1.3.0+49

- **PWA Viewport & Touch Alignment**: Removed viewport-locking position constraints in CSS to allow WebKit layout viewport to naturally align with touch coordinates in iOS standalone PWAs, resolving the first-launch vertical touch offset bug.
- **Adaptive Safe Area Logic**: Updated the onboarding screen to dynamically detect native PWA safe area insets via MediaQuery, only falling back to custom browser-chrome margins when native padding is zero.
